M18 — 2026-10-11
Pricing Claude Code tokens from transcripts: on the bench stack (claude-sonnet-5) cache writes are the one-hour kind (usage.cache_creation.ephemeral_1h_input_tokens), and the adapter's reported cost is exactly fresh input ×1 + cache write ×2 + cache read ×0.1 + output ×5, at $2 per million (within 0.3% on all 21 reps of 2.5 and 3.4). test-e2e/drive-lanes/measure.mjs TOKEN_WEIGHTS holds these weights. A subagent's own transcript (projects/<dir>/<session>/subagents/*.jsonl) has isSidechain:true on every line, so a parser that drops sidechain lines counts no subagent calls.
